elements.quote: Musculoskeletal disorders (MSDs) are frequent and disabling conditions in primary care and contribute substantially to general practitioners' (GPs) workload. Direct access (DA) to physiotherapy, allowing patients to consult physiotherapists without prior medical referral, has been proposed to streamline care, reduce delays, and optimise resource use.
elements.reason: The text describes the current state of knowledge regarding musculoskeletal disorders and the proposed benefits of direct access to physiotherapy.

elements.quote: To assess the impact of DA to physiotherapy on general practice for adult MSDs.

elements.quote: The findings of this review have differential implications depending on healthcare system architecture.
